observations: Photo 0 shows a rectangular UPS unit standing upright, tower-style casing.
Front panel reads "BLUE GATE" in white text, with a purple status strip and a single button, no visible display screen.
Power cord with a local-style plug is wound around the top and hangs loose.
No capacity/VA rating, model number, or serial sticker is visible on the unit.
Unit sits on a tiled floor next to other dark equipment (possibly a PC case or speaker) and some loose items.
No visible external damage, cracks, or burn marks on the casing.

claims.claim: Faulty blue gate UPS available for sale
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows no visible damage; the fault itself (e.g., not powering on, bad battery, no output) cannot be confirmed from a static image. Seller's description of a fault is taken as self-reported, not visually contradicted or supported.

risks.risk: Exact nature/extent of the fault (battery dead, circuit board failure, no output at all) unknown
risks.proof: A video showing the unit plugged in, powered on, and attempted to hold a load, or a clear fault description from seller (e.g., error beep codes)
risks.if_unproven: priced as fully non-functional / for-parts only

risks.proof: A close-up photo of the rating label (usually on the back or bottom of the unit)
risks.if_unproven: priced at the low end for an unspecified small-capacity faulty UPS

risks.risk: Battery may be missing, swollen, or leaking even if casing looks intact
risks.proof: Photo of the unit's rear panel or opened battery compartment

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage (cracks, water exposure) not visible from this angle
risks.proof: Additional photos from side, back, and bottom of the unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically unverified, default to worst case condition

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the rating/label sticker (VA/W capacity, model number)
Photo or video of the back/bottom panel showing ports and any damage
Short video attempting to power on the unit, showing any lights or sounds
Photo of the battery compartment if accessible
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Blue Gate brand UPS from the visible label, and the seller explicitly states it is faulty; with no capacity label or working-condition proof, it can be priced at worst case as a non-functional unit of unspecified rating.
